suggestions.title: Scope observed quota failures by project in agent class routing
suggestions.rationale: The Quota And Routing UAT plan requires per-project failure coverage for the Agent class router. The current router checks observed failures by agent and model only when quota is unknown, so a quota-shaped failure recorded for one project also blocks another project using the same agent/model. The required passing UAT is skipped until AgentClassRouter includes WorkItem.ProjectId when querying observed quota failures.
